text:
Forgive me, friend, I did not mean to bother you

but I came back from Vietnam

where I killed a lot of Vietnamese gentlemen

some ladies too

and I could not bear the pain

and out of fear I picked up a habit

and I went through rehab and I am clean

but I have nowhere to sleep

and I do not know what to do

with myself right now


I am sorry, friend, I did not mean to bother you

but it is cold in the street

and my heart is sick alone

and I am clean, but my life is a disaster

Third Avenue

and E. Houston Street

in the crosswalk under the red light

I clean your windshield with a dirty rag

translation.title: Lamentation of the Homeless
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the street address, confessional rush, and blunt veteran's voice of the provided text.
